nodes.label: All-in cash allocation and exit comparison
nodes.rationale: The new offline adapter explicitly supersedes the previous $100 drawdown constraint only for this simulation, preserves prior artifacts and keeps momentum confirmation and chronological single-entry selection. Drawdown is measured without threshold-based intervention.

nodes.label: Cash-only requested allocation with capacity-limited execution
nodes.rationale: Requested shares are floor(available settled cash divided by entry cap plus fee). Remove planning risk/notional/liquidity caps while preserving validated geometry, conservative reward/risk and 25% actual quote capacity. Overrides must remove inherited drawdown latching from every observer/blocking/report path.

nodes.label: fixed_15m, breakeven_1atr and trail_1atr
nodes.rationale: Three preregistered exploratory policies share frozen entry ATR, original target and a 15-minute first-fill deadline. Breakeven/trailing protection arms after one ATR of net marked gain; stops never decrease and activation does not guarantee a profitable exit.

nodes.label: Causal protective-exit event ordering
nodes.rationale: At quote receipt, preserve latched exits, check deadline, then existing stop/target, then update protection and test rounding crossings. Routing delay is added once; fills require strictly later quotes with capacity. Stale observations cannot arm or ratchet, and partial exits preserve reason/deadline.

nodes.label: Ten registered all-in runs
nodes.rationale: Exactly three policies under nominal, doubled-cost and doubled-timing fixtures plus one fixed_15m repeat produce ten runs and nine comparisons. Reused nine-session evidence is development-only; retain cash utilization, ratchets, partial fills, unknown intervals and unresolved exposure without unsupported selection or intervals.

nodes.label: SEC stop-order bulletin
nodes.rationale: Cited for the distinction between stop triggers/trailing levels and guaranteed execution prices; simulation assumptions remain explicit fixtures.
